project_name: BriefCraft AI - AI Meeting Brief Generator
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY ACCENTS

aesthetic_principles: Light-mode Executive Pristine: Off-white canvas (#F8F9FA) with warm bone/stone card backgrounds (#FFFFFF) and crisp 1px borders (#E5E7EB)
Editorial Swiss Typography: High-impact display headlines using 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Plus Jakarta Sans', crisp body text, and uppercase JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono for badges & meta-tags
Executive Brief Focus: Content-first one-page meeting briefs front-loading background, commitments, talking points, and source citations without digital slop or dark gradients
Micro-Tactile Controls: Pill-shaped badges, subtle hover lifts, status pulses, and glassmorphic floating actions

headings.family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif

metadata_and_mono.family: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
metadata_and_mono.usage: Used for meeting timestamps, source badges, confidence scores, CRM deal tags, and keyboard shortcuts

contrast_and_accessibility.rule: Always explicitly set dark text on light hover states and light text on primary dark button states.

layout_and_spacing.container_padding_rule: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (minimum p-5 or p-6) to prevent text clipping.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-6)
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Swiss Grid with generative white space, overlapping callout banners, feature cards, and asymmetric bento layouts
layout_and_spacing.brief_viewer_layout: Single-page executive document layout (2-column layout on desktop: 8-col main briefing + 4-col client/deal sidebar)

landing_page.hero: Bold headline ('Walk into every meeting with unfair advantage'), interactive live demo toggle, video/interactive brief preview
landing_page.features: Bento grid displaying Auto-Calendar sync, CRM Context Deep-Dive, Action Item Extractor, Custom Brief Templates
landing_page.example_brief_interactive: Interactive One-Page Brief preview with live tab switching (Background, Past Commitments, Talking Points, Questions, Sources)
landing_page.integrations: Interactive badge grid for Google Calendar, Outlook, Salesforce, Hubspot, Notion, Slack, Gmail
landing_page.pricing: Transparent tier cards (Freelancer, Executive, Pro Team) with monthly/yearly switch & usage comparison table
landing_page.faq_and_security: Accordion FAQ + SOC2/GDPR enterprise security guarantees

authentication.style: Clean light glass card split-screen with social OAuth (Google/Microsoft) and email magic link option

onboarding.steps: 1. Professional Role selection -> 2. Connect Calendars & CRM -> 3. Define Brief Depth & Notification Rules -> 4. Generate First Sample Brief

widgets: Upcoming Meetings Schedule (Today & Tomorrow timeline with brief status indicators: Ready, Syncing, Pending)
Quick Action Hero (Generate Instant Brief, Copy Summary to Clipboard, Send to Slack)
Recent Briefs Archive (Searchable grid/table with filter tags)
Monthly Usage Quota bar (e.g. 14 / 30 briefs used)

sections: Header Masthead (Meeting Title, Time, Attendees with CRM Avatars & Roles, Firm Name)
Executive Summary / Background Context (3 concise bullet points)
Unresolved Commitments (Open promises from previous emails/calls)
Citations & Sourced Evidence Footer (Clickable links to notes, calendar events, CRM deals)

client_memory.features: Searchable Contact & Organization directory with timeline of past briefs, key preferences, deal stages, and email interaction history

integrations_page.features: Grid of calendar, email, CRM, and note providers with Connect/Disconnect toggle buttons, sync health logs, and permission toggles

settings_and_admin.user_settings: Profile, Brief Custom Template builder, Default AI Prompt instructions, Notification Webhooks, Billing/Subscription portal
settings_and_admin.admin_interface: User management, Global quota controls, System prompt manager, API token usage monitoring chart

image_urls.description: Minimalist desk workspace with laptop for hero showcase

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react icons for UI elements and status indicators

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: subtle lift -translate-y-0.5 shadow-md border-sky-300 transition-all duration-200
motion_and_interaction.motion_library: framer-motion for smooth list staggered entrance, accordion collapse, and tab sliding highlight
motion_and_interaction.toast_notifications: sonner for crisp feedback toasts ('Brief generated successfully', 'Exported to PDF')

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='generate-brief-button', data-testid='meeting-card-1', data-testid='brief-talking-points-list').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the full React JS application with React Router DOM supporting all mentioned routes: Landing, Auth, Onboarding, Dashboard, Brief Viewer, Client Memory, Integrations, Settings, Admin.
Implement rich mock data for meetings (with realistic companies, CRM history, talking points, unresolved commitments, source links) so the app feels like a live production tool.
Provide full interactive capabilities: creating new briefs manually or via quick trigger, editing brief items inline, toggling integrations, searching client memory, updating settings.
Ensure every page header and navigation bar is styled with semi-opaque glassmorphism or clean solid border backdrop, maintaining flawless light mode legibility.
Attach data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and modal triggers to satisfy automated test requirements.
